skills.name: agent-instructions-improver
skills.description: Audit AGENTS.md quality, consolidate shared agent instruction files, or apply approved targeted updates to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Copilot instructions, Cursor rules, and project operating guides. Use for durable session-to-instructions capture or explicit agent-instruction quality work, not simple file lookup. Reports quality findings before proposing updates.
skills.quickStart: Ask the agent to audit AGENTS.md, then wait for the quality report before edits.

install.cli: npx skills add keelim/keelim-plugin --skill agent-instructions-improver -a codex -a claude-code -y --copy
